description: This file defines a class 'BesselJ' that provides methods to compute the Bessel function of the first kind (BesselJ). It includes functions for specific orders (0 and 1) and a general calculation method supporting array inputs. It contains detailed implementations for different ranges of input values and handles errors. The class appears to be part of a larger spreadsheet calculation library, specifically within the Engineering module.

classes.name: BesselJ
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate Bessel functions of the first kind for given input values and orders, with support for array inputs and error handling.

methods.name: BESSELJ
methods.description: Main public method to calculate the Bessel function for a given x and order. Supports array inputs and validates inputs, returning errors if inputs are invalid.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Private method to choose the appropriate specific Bessel function implementation based on the order.

methods.name: besselJ0
methods.description: Calculates the Bessel function of order 0 for a given float x.

methods.name: besselJ1
methods.description: Calculates the Bessel function of order 1 for a given float x.

methods.name: besselJ2
methods.description: Calculates the Bessel function for an arbitrary order, handling cases based on whether |x| is greater than the order.

methods.name: besselj2a
methods.description: Calculates Bessel function of order greater than x using upward recurrence.

methods.name: besselj2b
methods.description: Calculates Bessel function of order less than or equal to x using downward recurrence and series summation.
